1. This order may be cited as the Co-operative Societies (Assumption of

Control) (Revocation of Appointment) Order 2019.

Revocation of appointment

2. The appointment of Basuini bin Ali in the Co-operative Societies

(Assumption of Control) (Appointment) Order 2019 [P.U. (A) 50 /2019]

published in the Gazette on 22 February 2019 is revoked.

Made 29 October 2019

[SKM.IP(SULIT)KP: 451 A/1/3 JLD. 2; PN(PU2)527/XIX]

Datuk Nordin bin Salleh

Malaysia Co-operative Societies Commission

AKTA KOPERASI 1993

Perintah Koperasi (Pengambilalihan Kawalan) (Pelantikan) (No. 3) 2019

Pada menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh subseksyen 69(2) Akta Koperasi

1993 [Akta 502], Suruhanjaya membuat perintah yang berikut:

Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa

1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Koperasi (Pengambilalihan

Kawalan) (Pelantikan) (No. 3) 2019.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 November 2019.
6953 P.U. (A) 293.

Pengambilalihan kawalan

2. Suruhanjaya melantik Meor Mohammad Shariffudin bin Meor Yahya

untuk mengambil alih kawalan semua harta, urusan, aktiviti dan hal ehwal

Koperasi Automobil Kuching Sarawak Berhad dan menjalankan kesemua

urusan, aktiviti dan hal ehwalnya berkuat kuasa mulai 1 November 2019 hingga

20 September 2020 atau sehingga suatu Lembaga dipilih di bawah undang-undang

kecil koperasi itu, mengikut mana-mana yang terdahulu.

Kos dan perbelanjaan

3. Apa-apa kos dan perbelanjaan yang dilakukan oleh Suruhanjaya berhubung

dengan pengambilalihan kawalan di bawah perenggan 2 hendaklah kena dibayar

daripada dana dan harta Koperasi Automobil Kuching Sarawak Berhad sebagai

suatu caj pertama.

Dibuat 29 Oktober 2019

[SKM.IP.(SULIT)KP: 451 A/1/3 JLD. 2; PN(PU2)527/XIX]

 Datuk Nordin bin Salleh

Pengerusi Eksekutif

Suruhanjaya Koperasi Malaysia

CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES ACT 1993

Co-Operative Societies (Assumption of Control) (Appointment)

(No. 3) Order 2019

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the Co-operative

Societies Act 1993 [Act 502], the Commission makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Co-operative Societies (Assumption

of Control) (Appointment) (No. 3) Order 2019.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 November 2019.

Appointment of control

2. The Commission appoints Meor Mohammad Shariffudin bin Meor Yahya

to assume control of the whole of the property, business, activities and affairs

of the Koperasi Automobil Kuching Sarawak Berhad and carry on the whole

of its business, activities and affairs with effect from 1 November 2019 to

20 September 2020 or until a Board is elected under the by-laws of the

co-operative society, whichever is earlier.

Costs and expenses

3. Any costs and expenses incurred by the Commission in relation to the

assumption of control under paragraph 2 shall be payable out of the funds

and properties of the Koperasi Automobil Kuching Sarawak Berhad as a first

charge.

Made 29 October 2019

[SKM.IP.(SULIT)KP: 451 A/1/3 JLD. 2; PN(PU2)527/XIX]

Datuk Nordin bin Salleh

Executive Chairman

Malaysia Co-operative Societies Commission

P.U. (A) 294.

INTERNATIONAL TRADE IN ENDANGERED SPECIES ACT 2008

International Trade in Endangered Species (Amendment of

First Schedule) Order 2019

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 6(2) of the International Trade

in Endangered Species Act 2008 [Act 686], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the International Trade in Endangered

Species (Amendment of First Schedule) Order 2019.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 November 2019.

P.U. (A) 294.

Amendment of First Schedule

2. The First Schedule of the International Trade in Endangered Species Act 2008

is amended—

(a) by substituting for the item "Department of Wildlife and National

Parks, Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment Malaysia"

and particulars relating to it the following item and particulars:

Management Authority Species Region

"Department of Wildlife and

National Parks Peninsular

Malaysia

Terrestrial

animals

Peninsular Malaysia and the

Federal Territory of Labuan";

(b) by substituting for the item "Department of Fisheries, Ministry of

Agriculture and Agro-Based Industries Malaysia" and particulars

relating to it the following item and particulars:

Management Authority Species Region

"Department of Fisheries

Malaysia

Marine animals,

freshwater fish

and marine fish

Peninsular Malaysia and the

Federal Territory of Labuan";

(c) in column "Region" in relation to "Malaysian Timber Industry Board",

by substituting for the words "Peninsular Malaysia, the Federal

Territory of Labuan, the Federal Territory of Putrajaya and Sabah"

(d) by substituting for the item "Department of Agriculture, Ministry of

Agriculture and Agro-Based Industries Malaysia" and particulars

relating to it the following item and particulars:

"Department of Agriculture Terrestrial

plants

(artificially

propagated)

Federal Territory of Labuan";

relating to it the following item and particulars:

Terrestrial

plants (except

artificially

propagated)

Perdagangan Antarabangsa mengenai Spesies Terancam 2008 [Akta 686],

Menteri, dengan persetujuan Pihak Berkuasa Negeri Sabah, membuat perintah

yang berikut:

Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa

1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perdagangan Antarabangsa

mengenai Spesies Terancam (Pindaan Jadual Pertama) (No. 2) 2019.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 November 2019.

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

2. Jadual Pertama kepada Akta Perdagangan Antarabangsa mengenai Spesies

Terancam 2008 dipinda—

(a) dalam ruang "Spesies" berhubung dengan "Jabatan Hidupan Liar

Sabah", dengan menggantikan perkataan "Haiwan (kecuali ikan dan

batu karang) dan tumbuhan (kecuali tumbuhan marin dan kayu)"

dengan perkataan "Haiwan daratan, haiwan marin (mamalia dan

(b) dalam ruang "Spesies" berhubung dengan "Jabatan Perikanan Sabah",

dengan menggantikan perkataan "Ikan, batu karang dan tumbuhan

marin" dengan perkataan "Haiwan marin (kecuali mamalia dan penyu),

butir-butir yang berhubungan dengannya butiran dan butir-butir yang

berikut:

Pihak Berkuasa Pengurusan Spesies Kawasan

"Jabatan Perhutanan Sabah Kayu Sabah".

Peralihan

3. Apa-apa permit, perakuan atau pendaftaran yang dikeluarkan oleh Lembaga

Perindustrian Kayu Malaysia di bawah Akta hendaklah terus berkuat kuasa

sehingga habisnya tempoh permit, perakuan atau pendaftaran itu.

Dibuat 21 Oktober 2019

[NRE/PUU/611-5/12; PN(PU2)672/IV]

Menteri Air, Tanah dan Sumber Asli

INTERNATIONAL TRADE IN ENDANGERED SPECIES ACT 2008

International Trade in Endangered Species (Amendment of

First Schedule) Order (No. 2) 2019

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsections 6(2) and 6(3) of the

International Trade in Endangered Species Act 2008 [Act 686], the Minister,

with the consent of the State Authority of the State of Sabah, makes the

following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the International Trade in Endangered

Species (Amendment of First Schedule) Order (No. 2) 2019.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 November 2019.

Amendment of First Schedule

2. The First Schedule of the International Trade in Endangered Species Act

2008 is amended—

(a) in column "Species" in relation to "Sabah Wildlife Department", by

substituting for the words "Animal (except fish and coral) and plant

(except marine plant and timber)" the words "Terrestrial animal,

marine animal (mammals and turtle only) and terrestrial plants";

(b) in column "Species" in relation to "Sabah Fisheries Department", by

substituting for the words "Fish, coral and marine plant" the words

"Marine animal (except mammals and turtle), freshwater fish and

marine fish"; and

(c) by inserting after the item "Sabah Fisheries Department" and particulars

relating to it the following item and particulars:

Management Authority Species Region

"Sabah Forestry Department Timber Sabah".

Transitional

3. Any permit, certificate or registration issued by the Malaysian Timber

Industry Board under this Act shall continue to remain in full force until the

expiry date of the permit, certificate or registration.

Made 21 October 2019

[NRE/PUU/611-5/12; PN(PU2)672/IV]

Dr. Xavier Jayakumar a/l Arulanandam

Minister of Water, Land and Natural Resources

P.U. (A) 295.

P.U. (A) 296.
